COMPANY OVERVIEW

TransGrid Energy is a renewable energy company focused on investing, developing, owning and operating utility-scale battery energy storage systems and PV projects. TransGrid has a robust pipeline of projects under construction and in late-stage development, and the Company is actively expanding its energy asset portfolio across the United States.

As an affiliate company of Hanwha Group, a FORTUNE Global 500 company driven by a firm commitment to advancing the clean energy future, TransGrid Energy is striving to shape the renewable energy landscape by providing sustainable and reliable power solutions tailored to meet the energy needs of today and tomorrow.

POSITION OVERVIEW

TransGrid Energy is seeking an Asset Operations Manager to assist with the management of assets within the company's portfolio. This role involves collaboration with internal teams and external stakeholders to help ensure the optimal and compliant operations of the assets, with a strong emphasis on the technical operations and maintenance of utility-scale Solar PV and Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) assets.

This position is responsible for the project operations in accordance with requirements in a manner that maximizes availability and performance.


RESPONSIBILITIES

· Monitor, track, and support day-to-day operations and maintenance of utility-scale Solar PV and BESS assets to ensure high performance and availability, maximizing ROA through fleet availability and market participation. Identify issues and work with stakeholders to remedy.

· Manage and troubleshoot utility-scale Solar PV systems including SMA inverters, DC collection systems, tracker operations, and AC interconnection to maximize performance and availability.

· Oversee daily operations of Tesla Megapack and LG Energy Solution BESS installations, monitoring state of charge, thermal management, and battery health metrics to ensure dispatch readiness and system integrity.

· Utilize SCADA platforms as the primary monitoring and diagnostic tool for assigned assets, managing alarms, real-time performance data, and operational events across PV and BESS systems.

· Develop CMMS systems for work order management, preventive maintenance scheduling, and asset performance tracking.

· Troubleshoot operational issues with asset performance, scheduling, and market alignment. Collaborate with stakeholders to develop and implement corrective actions.

· Implement initiatives to improve assigned assets and overall business profitability and efficiency.

· Onboard projects in the execution phase in preparation for operations.

· Direct third-party O&M vendors to ensure efficient operation and contractual compliance.

· Implement corrective and preventive maintenance programs to maximize fleet availability and performance.

· Identify deficiencies and submit and manage warranty claims through resolution.

· Coordinate tasks related to operational compliance with contractual and regulatory requirements.

· Manage and administer project agreements ensuring TGE and external stakeholder obligations are fulfilled in a timely manner.

· Oversee performance of suppliers and contractors ensuring contractual obligations are satisfied.

· Support accurate and timely financial reporting for assigned assets by coordinating with TGE's finance and accounting teams.

· Prepare operations and other applicable reports, including lender and tax equity reporting as required.

· Provide data-driven operational insights to leadership to support strategic initiatives.

· Document and streamline operations and market participation processes.

· Collaborate with other departments to ensure project needs are met.

· Perform other duties and special projects as assigned

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

· Bachelor's degree or higher in engineering or a related technical field preferred; degrees in business, economics, or a related field will be considered.

· Minimum of 6 years of experience in utility-scale solar PV and BESS operations and maintenance, asset management, and energy market activities.

· Highly skilled in utility-scale solar PV systems including module technology, DC collection systems, string and central inverters, tracker systems, and AC interconnection.

· Hands-on experience with SMA utility-scale inverters including fault diagnostics, firmware management, and performance optimization.

· Demonstrated experience with Tesla Megapack and/or LG Energy Solution BESS platforms including monitoring, troubleshooting, and coordination with OEM technical support.

· Proficiency in SCADA platforms for real-time monitoring, alarm management, and performance analysis of utility-scale PV and BESS assets.

· Experience with CMMS platforms (Maximo, SAP PM, UpKeep, or equivalent) for work order management and preventive maintenance scheduling.

· Strong understanding of agreements such as FA, LGIA, AMA, LTSA, OMA, SFA, and PPA.

· Familiarity and understanding of NERC compliance and reporting.

· Working knowledge of energy market operations and asset scheduling.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

· NABCEP Photovoltaic Installation Professional (PVIP) or PV Technical Sales (PVTS) certification.

· NFPA 855 Standard for the Installation of Stationary Energy Storage Systems awareness training or certification.

· NERC Reliability certification applicable to generation and storage operations.

· OSHA 30-Hour General Industry or Construction certification.

· Additional inverter OEM certifications (Huawei, SolarEdge, or equivalent).

· Experience with additional BESS OEM platforms (Fluence, BYD, CATL, or equivalent).

WORK AUTHORIZATION

Candidates must have authorization to work in the US prior to joining TransGrid Energy LLC. This role does not sponsor or offer assistance with work authorization in the United States.

DIVERSITY AND INCLUSION

TransGrid Energy believes that diversity and inclusion are vital to our success. By embracing different ideas and approaches, we enhance our ability to deliver the best results for our employees, environment, and business partners. We foster a culture where all colleagues can share their passions and ideas to collectively overcome industry challenges and work toward a brighter future.

TransGrid Energy is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, age, or any other federally protected class.
